title: Localization & Multiscript Validation
objective: Memvalidasi locale, RTL, text expansion, kalender, unit, tanggal, conlang, dan nama multiskrip.

locale_results.description: Locale yang didukung aplikasi (en/id), deteksi locale tak didukung, dan fallback ke en.

rtl_results.description: Deteksi locale RTL (ar/he/fa), arah teks per locale, dan kebutuhan mirror layout.

expansion_results.description: Faktor ekspansi label UI terhadap baseline en per locale, locale terpanjang, dan anggaran 2.0x.

calendar_results.description: Kalender kustom dirender per urutan locale (ymd/dmy) dan format-parse round-trip identik.

unit_results.description: Konversi metrik-imperial round-trip dan pemisah desimal/puluhan per locale.

multiscript_results.description: Nama multiskrip (Cyrillic/CJK/Arabic/Devanagari/Latin) utuh UTF-8 tanpa replacement character; nama kosong ditolak.

limits: Domain-level fixtures and heuristics only: expansion labels are a fixed sample, RTL/mirroring is locale-list driven (no live widget layout capture), calendar/unit/locale formatting is domain logic without native Intl/ICU or GUI verification. Native RTL layout mirroring, IME, full locale translation, hosted CI, hardware, and public release DEFERRED/UNVERIFIABLE.
